build_BertEncoder: build a BertEncoder that loads a pretrained BERT model and encodes text with attention masks
build_BertClf: build a BertClf classifier that combines a BertEncoder with a linear classification head
test_BertEncoder_forward: test the BertEncoder forward pass with token ids, attention mask, and segment ids
test_BertClf_forward: test the BertClf forward pass to get classification logits from encoded text
review_BertClf_initialization: review the BertClf class and its initialization of the encoder and linear classifier layers
